name: Net Friend ~Kanojo ni Deatta Watashi no Matsuro~
original_name: ネットフレンド ～彼女に出会った私の末路～
source:
Female college student Nagisa Hanazono met a woman on the internet.

Her name was "Wakaba".
She was exactly Nagisa's type.

One day, in a stroke of luck, they meet and go out in real life.

All the while, Wakaba has some evil plans for Nagisa...

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21394]Freem![/url]]
translation:
女大学生花园渚在网上认识了一位女性。

她的名字叫“若叶”。
她正是渚的类型。

有一天，幸运的是，他们在现实生活中相遇并出去了。

一直以来，若叶对渚都有一些邪恶的计划……

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/21394]Freem![/url]]
